# Acolyte (`backgrounds:acolyte`)
**Ability Scores:** [INT](../ability-scores/int.md), [WIS](../ability-scores/wis.md), [CHA](../ability-scores/cha.md)
**Feat:** [Magic Initiate](../feats/magic-initiate.md) (Cleric)
**Proficiencies:** [Skill: Insight](../proficiencies/skill-insight.md), [Skill: Religion](../proficiencies/skill-religion.md), [Tool: Calligrapher's Supplies](../proficiencies/tool-calligraphers-supplies.md)

## Equipment Options
- Choose A or B: (A) Calligrapher's Supplies, Book (prayers), Holy Symbol, Parchment (10 sheets), Robe, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP ([Calligrapher's Supplies](../equipment/calligraphers-supplies.md), [Book](../equipment/book.md), [Holy Symbols](../equipment-categories/holy-symbols.md), [Parchment](../equipment/parchment.md), [Robe](../equipment/robe.md))

# Soldier (`backgrounds:soldier`)
**Ability Scores:** [STR](../ability-scores/str.md), [DEX](../ability-scores/dex.md), [CON](../ability-scores/con.md)
**Feat:** [Savage Attacker](../feats/savage-attacker.md)
**Proficiencies:** [Skill: Athletics](../proficiencies/skill-athletics.md), [Skill: Intimidation](../proficiencies/skill-intimidation.md)
**Proficiency Choice:** Choose one kind of Gaming Set (see "Equipment") ([Tool: Dice](../proficiencies/tool-dice.md), [Tool: Dragonchess](../proficiencies/tool-dragonchess.md), [Tool: Playing Cards](../proficiencies/tool-playing-cards.md), [Tool: Three-Dragon Ante](../proficiencies/tool-three-dragon-ante.md))

## Equipment Options
- Choose A or B: (A) Spear, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Gaming Set (same as above), Healer's Kit, Quiver, Traveler's Clothes, 14 GP; or (B) 50 GP ([Spear](../equipment/spear.md), [Shortbow](../equipment/shortbow.md), [Arrows](../equipment/arrows.md), [Gaming Sets](../equipment-categories/gaming-sets.md), [Healer's Kit](../equipment/healers-kit.md), [Quiver](../equipment/quiver.md), [Clothes, Traveler's](../equipment/clothes-travelers.md))
